headline: The opposition criticized the measures against high fuel prices
summary: The cabinet announced measures against high prices, corruption and for security. The opposition criticized the fuel-price measures, triggering political reactions in parliament.
why: Fuel prices feed directly into transport and input costs across the economy, so government measures to cap or manage them affect inflation expectations and consumer spending.
